checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Papers and empty takeaway cup absent
must.why: Front papers, rear stack and cup are all gone.

must.item: Laptop, mug and cables intact in original positions
must.why: All remain in place, with only slight softening.

must.item: Exposed desk has believable texture and lighting, no fragments
must.why: Wood grain looks continuous and clean, with no leftover fragments.
The framing, window, wall and monitor arm are unchanged.

faults.what: The small crumpled wrapper was removed even though the user said to leave it. The assistant's message also says it was left.
The desk is slightly smoother and more saturated orange than the original. The right desk edge is a little different.

summary: The papers and cup are cleanly removed and the desk fill looks natural. The laptop, mug and cables are preserved, but the wrapper that was meant to stay is also gone.
